environment.description: Same service deployed on ECS Fargate. PostgreSQL RDS instance configured with a separate database role 'app_ro_7f3a' created via Terraform module 'rds-restricted-role' with explicit privilege grant: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO app_ro_7f3a; ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO app_ro_7f3a; REVOKE INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public FROM app_ro_7f3a. The DATABASE_USER environment variable is set to 'app_ro_7f3a'. Container runs Java 17.0.8 with default ObjectInputFilter logging (no blocking filter). Network egress allowed to RDS and ECR endpoints only via VPC security group sg-0a4f2e8b (outbound rules: port 5432 to RDS SG, port 443 to com.amazonaws.us-east-1.ecr.api/dkr VPC endpoints). Classpath includes commons-collections4 (safe) and spring-core 6.0.x.

config.db_grants: SELECT-only on all tables, explicit REVOKE of INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE
config.network_egress: restricted via SG sg-0a4f2e8b: only port 5432 to RDS SG and port 443 to ECR VPC endpoints
config.jdk_serial_filter: logging only, pattern-based reject for known gadgets
